Sorry for my poor English.
This is a complex feature, but definitely helpful for people to create VRChat content, video or film.
add some camera features for creating films and videos,  allow the camera to move by the keyframes(timeline) placed by the player in the world.
Including:
* Adjustable FOV / DOF...
  >> FOV / DOF/ Post-Processing / 
  >> fixed or adjust by keyframes placed on the timeline
* Receive audio
  >> When using stream camera, the audio send to PC will be the audio heard by the camera instead of the player 
* (Custom) camera movement
  >> Movement, rotation, pitch
  >> controlled by keyframes placed on the timeline
Concept example:
 Timeline |------[A]-----------[B]-----------[C]-------------[D]------------[E]-------------|
  A: Go to coordinate 15,24,32 in 5 seconds
  B: Rotate by X for 30°, pitch left for 25° in 3 seconds
  C: Enable Filter {filtername}
  D: Set Fov to 32
  E: Wait for 7 seconds
  ... etc
title: Movie studio camera features
